movelist.name: Aromatherapy
movelist.effect: All allies in the burst are cured of one status condition of their choice.

movelist.name: Grassy Terrain
movelist.effect: The area becomes Grassy for 5 rounds. While Grassy, all Pokémon and Trainers standing on the ground recover a Tick of Hit Points at the start of every turn, and Grass-Type attacks performed by grounded Pokémon and Trainers gain a +10 bonus to Damage Rolls.

movelist.name: Wish
movelist.effect: At the end of the user’s next turn, the target regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If the user targets themselves and are replaced in battle, the replacement is healed.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Flower Power
abilities.effect: The user may perform damaging Grass Type Moves as if they were their choice of either Physical or Special.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.effect: The user gains Last Chance with Grass.

abilities.name: Symbiosis
abilities.effect: The user choses a Held Item they are holding. If the target is willing, they also gain the effects of the chosen item for the rest of the Scene. Items that are activated at a frequency may be activated independently by the user and the the target.
